name: AppearanceProvider
description: Provide persisted appearance preferences and synchronize theme, palette, density, motion and typography with the document. Also installs the pointer light for lit glass (`installPointerLight`), the shared shimmer beat (`installShimmerSync`) and, when the application selects baked glass rendering, the baked frost (`installBakedFrost`).
